This item weighs over 20kg, please ensure you have suitable assistance and transport when collecting from store. We cannot accept the return of unwanted boilers if the box/packaging has been opened (your statutory rights are not affected).

British-built, simple to use, high-efficiency combi boiler. Lightweight and compact dimensions allow for installation within 290mm deep cupboards. Features LPG conversion for converting between natural gas or LPG without the need for an additional kit. Adey MagnaClean Micro2 filter provides boiler and heating system protection. Includes built-in pipes behind the facility within the boiler casing, brass hydraulics and stainless steel heat exchanger. Also supplied with Easy-Fill 2 filling link, enabling easy and quick top-up of system pressure, and preheated siphonic condensate trap to prevent freezing. Compatible with existing Baxi Flues and Baxi Internal fit flue. Can be used with Baxi uSense devices and smart heating controls.
